name: Duo
description: Balance suns and moons in every row and column

rules.title: How to Play
rules.rule1: Each row and column must have equal suns and moons
rules.rule2: Never place three of the same symbol consecutively, horizontally or vertically.
rules.rule3: All rows must be unique, all columns must be unique

conflicts.duplicateRows: Rows {lines} are identical. Every row must be unique.
conflicts.duplicateColumns: Columns {lines} are identical. Every column must be unique.
conflicts.consecutive: No more than two suns or moons in a row or column.
conflicts.imbalance: Each row and column must have the same number of suns and moons.
